summary.caption: A spectacular isometric cutaway through a vertical solarpunk research station at dusk, four distinct inhabited rooms connected by stairs and transparent service shafts, warm interior pools of light against a deep teal landscape, intricate cinematic worldbuilding and coherent architectural perspective.

items.label: text
items.caption: Compact luminous ivory architectural title centred above the structure.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper-left greenhouse laboratory room with curved glass walls, hanging plants, seed vaults and a botanist tending glowing specimens.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper-right observatory room with a large circular telescope window, star charts and an astronomer at a brass console.

items.label: object
items.caption: Lower-left communal kitchen and library room, long timber table, shelves, steam and several residents sharing a late meal.

items.label: object
items.caption: Lower-right turbine workshop room with turquoise machinery, suspended tools and an engineer repairing a compact wind generator.
